title: A system font copy is known by its path, not only by its source kind
rule: When code must protect or mark files in the system font folders (rule 4: never move, trash or write them), decide per file by path: the file is inside one of fm_platform::paths::system_font_folders() (plus their resolved links), compared with is_within(Os::current(), ...), OR its source is SourceKind::System. Never rely on the source kind alone: no production code creates a System source, and a user can add an OS font folder (~/Library/Fonts, ~/.local/share/fonts, %LOCALAPPDATA%/Microsoft/Windows/Fonts) as an ordinary watched folder. Test it with a copy under a Watched source whose folder is passed in as an OS font folder.
rationale: E56.1 (#661): keep_copy and the duplicate sets' `system` mark checked only `source.kind = 'system'`, which a real index never holds, so a font in a watched OS font folder could be trashed.
